data.title: Payment Instruction Velocity Spike
data.description: Detects when multiple payment instructions (wires, ACH batches, or internal transfers) are submitted in rapid succession from a single account or user session. High-velocity payment submissions suggest automated or scripted fraud execution, often seen after credential compromise.
falsepositives: Corporate treasury operations submitting batch payments during end-of-day processing
Payroll administrators processing multi-entity payroll batches
